title: Keep OpenFeature evaluation namespaces concrete
answers: Why are flag evaluation requests rejected for a namespace mismatch?
How should OpenFeature handle a wildcard service-token namespace?
Which namespace and targeting key should the evaluation context use?
body:
Symptom: Flag evaluation requests using a cluster-wide service token are rejected for a namespace mismatch.
Root cause: pkg/services/contexthandler/contexthandler.go:ContextHandler.setRequestContext used the identity's wildcard namespace as the evaluation namespace and targeting key, conflicting with the caller's concrete auth namespace.
Fix pattern: Select a nonempty, non-wildcard identity namespace first; otherwise use "stacks-" + cfg.StackID when set, then "default". Use the selected namespace for both the evaluation context's namespace attribute and targeting key.
Constraints: This selection applies to request OpenFeature evaluation context. A concrete identity namespace takes precedence over StackID; empty or "*" identity namespaces must fall back. pkg/services/contexthandler/contexthandler_test.go:TestContextHandler verifies selection and agreement between the namespace attribute and targeting key.
applies: Request OpenFeature evaluation context constructed by ContextHandler.setRequestContext.
